Ducke HJBR 29036 (RB, duplicates: F, GH, K, MG, MO, NY, P, S). Syntype: A. Ducke HJBR 29037 (K, RB, S). Here we select as lectotype A. Ducke HJBR 29036, considering that the collection A.
